environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.28). Pod spec includes securityContext with capabilities drop list [CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN] and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. The namespace has a Cilium NetworkPolicy with L7 HTTP-aware filtering that restricts egress from the pod to only backend-service.internal:80 via FQDN-based policy selector with DNS proxy interception. Additionally, the pod runs under a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) which restricts raw socket syscalls. The Cilium L7 policy performs HTTP header inspection on egress and drops connections where the resolved destination IP does not match the cluster-internal DNS A record for backend-service.internal.

config.network_policies: Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy with L7 HTTP egress filtering, FQDN-based toFQDNs matchName: backend-service.internal, DNS proxy enabled
config.cilium_dns_proxy: enabled - intercepts DNS queries, only allows resolution of backend-service.internal
config.egress_restriction: L7 HTTP-aware policy blocks egress to any host not matching backend-service.internal A record
